name: Meenakshi Raman
headline: 73, field associate for a university ethnobotany study, Kodaikanal
title: Rain and the Healer's Name
situation: The sky turned grey over the Palani hills, and the university researchers were packing their clipboards and sample bags, muttering about the rain that was minutes away. One of the young researchers held up a fresh plant specimen that Meenakshi recognized as periya maruthu, but he was already writing the Latin name from his book on the label. 'We have to move now,' he said, 'we can confirm it later.' He waited, marker poised, expecting her quick nod. Meenakshi stood there in the wet leaves, knowing that if she did not speak up now, this name would be recorded without the healer who taught her the remedy.

context.relationship_profiles:
The young researcher is a polite Chennai student who often defers to her but is impatient when rain threatens.
The healer who taught her periya maruthu is an elderly woman from a nearby hamlet who trusts Meenakshi to keep her name attached.
The lead researcher respects her knowledge but treats name correction as a paperwork matter that can be fixed later.
context.tendencies:
She has twice halted documentation to ask who taught a remedy before allowing the Latin name to be written.
On previous field days she waited through light rain to ensure a healer's name was included on a specimen label.
She insists that local names be written beside Latin ones during every recording session.
context.current_state:
Her sandals are damp from walking on wet leaves, and her file folder feels heavy under her arm.
She has been on her feet since before dawn, but her hands are still steady from years of work.
The forest has gone quiet with the approaching storm, yet she is familiar and at ease in this space.
context.immediate_memories:
Seeing periya maruthu brings back the morning Kaveri showed her how to strip the bark and steep it for fever.
The researcher's marker recalls a past incident when a name was written without a healer's consent and she had to have it struck out.
The gathering grey clouds remind her of another drenching walk when she carried a specimen home to protect it.
context.reflective_memories:
She has watched university teams leave without acknowledging local healers in four previous surveys she assisted.
She remembers her mother's instruction that knowledge must be given back to the one who shared it.
She has seen young researchers correct their labels years later when a healer's name was omitted.
